Dont: Single chart with too much information

Short: Emphasize data trends over decoration
Do: Keep chart clean and data-focused
Dont: Heavy gradients/shadows obscuring data

Short: Grid lines should be low-contrast so they don't compete with data
Do: Use subtle gray grid lines (gray-200)
Dont: Bold grid lines competing with data elements

Short: Interactive chart elements must be keyboard-navigable
Do: Make chart points/bars/slices focusable
Dont: Non-focusable interactive chart elements

Short: Provide text summary or aria-label describing chart's key insight
Do: Add descriptive aria-label summarizing chart purpose
Dont: Charts invisible to screen readers

Short: Data load failure must show error with retry action
Do: Show error message with retry on chart load failure
Dont: Broken or empty chart on data failure

Short: Offer CSV/image export of chart data for data-heavy products
Do: Provide data export option for complex charts
Dont: No way to extract chart data

Short: Drill-down must maintain clear back-path and hierarchy breadcrumb
Do: Show breadcrumb/back navigation in drill-down views
Dont: Drill-down with no way back to overview

Short: Time series must clearly label time granularity and allow switching
Do: Label time scale and provide granularity controls
Dont: Ambiguous time axis with no granularity indicator
